newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 slides lower at close.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 slides lower at close.

text.p: Czech shares continued to stagnate and the main indices closed lower on Thursday after a modest gain to the PX50 in the previous session had raised hopes that the long awaited rebound on the Prague bourse may have been about to begin.
The PX50 lost 1.9 points, 0.38 percent, to 501.2 while the RPIX dipped six to 1,027.
Nevertheless, despite the generally gloomy mood among traders and analysts, some detetected signs that demand may be gradually picking up.
"I'm feeling that some of the undervalued stocks are moving back (up) a bit," said Lubomir Vystavel.
"We are starting to see some more activivty but it is not as high as I was hoping for," he added.

Most activity on the bourse on Thursday and throughout this week focused on major issues, especially SPT Telecom and Komercni Banka, both of which released nine month financial results last week which were within the range of most analysts' expectations.
Both SPT and Komercni closed five crowns lower on the bourse to 2,865 and 2,120 respectively. Traders said similar prices were being quoted on the over-the-counter market.
